description: Draw over the user's 3D view, as an extension's overlay, to point things out: items are { line: [points], closed? }, { box: { min, max } }, { point } or { label, at } (points in plan mm, x east, y north, with height mm), each with an optional colour (CSS; default orange, or colour for all). id names the layer: drawing the same id again replaces it. They draw on top of the model (on_top false hides them behind it). Not saved and not an undo step; clear_overlay takes them away. Returns the id and how many items.

at.description: Plan point in mm (x east, y north) and a height

max.description: Plan point in mm (x east, y north) and a height

min.description: Plan point in mm (x east, y north) and a height

items.description: Plan point in mm (x east, y north) and a height

point.description: Plan point in mm (x east, y north) and a height

title: Draw over the view
